text: Nineteen videos ago, Thornridge was running 340,000 policies on a 13-plus-year-old on-prem server with no tested recovery plan. This is the honest ending -- not a highlight reel -- of what actually changed.
What got built is real: a secured, geo-replicated Azure SQL Database, a failover actually drilled with a real gap fixed, automated maintenance, CI/CD, and live monitoring.
What's still open: the drill schedule depends on a human running it, the old on-prem server hasn't been decommissioned, and the Query Store baseline will need re-capture as volume grows.
This solved the real problem we scoped and found a real gap in the process along the way. It didn't automate the drill, retire the old server, or solve re-baselining -- those are named, not hidden.
Thornridge Insurance now runs on a database that's been migrated, secured, and genuinely tested -- bugs, drills, and honest gaps included. That's the series.
